visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with an extreme close-up of a white porcelain bowl containing steamed white rice topped with savory minced meat sauce and a fried egg with a runny yolk. A pair of dark chopsticks gently pierces the yolk, causing the golden liquid to flow over the meat. (2) The camera cuts to a top-down view of a black frying pan where Mapo Tofu is simmering; vibrant green scallions and sliced red chilies are scattered across the top of the white tofu cubes and brown meat sauce. (3) A middle-aged man wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a blue baseball cap stands in a modern, brightly lit white kitchen. He looks directly at the camera with a neutral but communicative expression. (4) The man is then seen in a dimly lit dining room, holding the bowl of rice and tofu, bringing a large spoonful to his mouth and chewing enthusiastically. (5) On a white kitchen countertop, several ingredients are arranged: a package of raw minced pork, a container of 'Zhonghua' brand tofu, a small purple bowl of chopped scallions, and a green sachet of Mapo sauce. (6) A hand holds a white bowl under a modern black water tap, filling the bowl which already contains the reddish-brown sauce base. (7) Back in the kitchen, the man adds sliced red chilies to a small pink bowl. (8) The camera focuses on the black pan where minced meat is being stir-fried with a black spatula. (9) The man pours the prepared sauce from the white bowl over the tofu cubes in the pan. (10) A glass lid is placed over the simmering pan, and a hand adjusts the steam vent. (11) The man and a woman stand together behind the stove, smiling at the camera as the man continues to stir the dish. (12) A young girl sits at a dining table, eagerly taking a large bite of the rice and Mapo Tofu mixture. (13) Finally, the man, the young girl, and another woman sit together at the dining table, all eating the dish and giving a thumbs-up gesture towards the camera in a brightly lit living/dining area.

(3) The rhythmic sizzling of meat frying in a pan creates a broadband noise layer that complements the high-frequency percussion of the BGM. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Ingredients -> Process -> Result -> Testimonial
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an energetic and accessible cooking tutorial for Mapo Tofu, specifically endorsing 'Xiao Mo Fang' brand seasoning. It uses the narrative hook that the dish is 'too dangerous' to cook because it makes people eat too much rice, transitioning into a clear step-by-step guide, and concluding with a warm family testimonial to emphasize the product's flavor and ease of use.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically lists 'Xiao Mo Fang' Mapo Sauce as a required ingredient, displays the packaging clearly, and mentions sending an invoice to the brand.
